why: A states Prop 2.44 on the model of a tame chart φ : V → O: faces of the M-polyfold O through φx (count d_X(x); each a tame sub-M-polyfold OF O with d_F(φx)+1 = d_X(x)) and, for σ ⊆ I(φx), only the GERM of the corner: A_σ = φ⁻¹(B ∩ ⋂_{i∈σ} F_i) for some small open B is a tame sub-M-polyfold of X with d_{A_σ} + #σ = d_X on A_σ; codimension is never stated. B uses an open V ∋ x with its induced structure and asserts that each face of V through x and each intersection ⋂₀σ of WHOLE faces of V is a tame sub-M-polyfold of X, with a codimension clause (HasCodimAtB: cut out in a chart by a closed subspace of codimension #σ). A ⇒ B is believed true with V = dom φ but is more than glue: besides the V ↔ O face transfer (done: A_to_B_count proves B's face-count clause from A, rt_check OK, with the V2_48 glue), it needs the germ-to-global step — ⋂_{i∈σ} F_i (and each whole face φ⁻¹(F)) is a tame sub-M-polyfold of X at EVERY point, i.e. corner_retraction/corner_tameModel applied at every point of the intersection, identification of the faces they produce there with the F_i (Lemma 2.40), and the chart construction of proposition_2_5_16_corner re-run pointwise — plus a new linear-algebra computation rank(E₀/⋂_{i∈σ} ker λ_i) = #σ for the codimension. B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B's V is an unspecified neighbourhood with no chart, so B says nothing about faces of a chart model O (proposition_2_5_16, proposition_2_42's model clause), nor about whole faces of a tame retract (proposition_2_5_15_isTame), nor the constructions corner_retraction / corner_tameModel / degIndexWith_eq_quadrantDeg_cornerProj_add_card; and A's corner has d_A + #σ = d_X at every point of A, B only at x.
